title: How to book an event with your Cult Pass
body: Open the Cult Pass app, browse events, and tap 'Reserve'. Classic members can hold up to 2 active reservations; Plus and Elite have no cap. Reservations confirm instantly when capacity is available; otherwise you join the waitlist (see article cp_kb_004). Tickets appear in the app Wallet 24 hours before doors open.

title: Refund policy for events and subscriptions
body: Event tickets are refundable up to 24 hours before the start time. Inside 24 hours we don't refund event fees but you can transfer the seat to another member for free. Subscription refunds: monthly plans within 14 days, annual plans prorated within 30 days. Duplicate charges are always refunded in full.

title: Cult Pass membership tiers (Classic, Plus, Elite)
body: Classic: 2 free events/month, no plus-ones. Plus: unlimited free events, 1 plus-one per event, early access. Elite: everything in Plus plus members-only food experiences, lounge access, and 4 plus-ones per event. Upgrades take effect immediately (prorated). Downgrades schedule for the next renewal.

title: Joining the waitlist for a sold-out event
body: If an event is full, tap 'Join waitlist' and we'll auto-confirm you in waitlist order if a seat opens. Waitlist spots release automatically 6 hours before doors. You can be on multiple waitlists, but if two confirm simultaneously you keep whichever you tap first.

title: Cancelling and rescheduling a booking
body: Open My Tickets, choose the booking, and tap 'Cancel'. Cancellations more than 24h before the event return your booking allowance immediately. Inside 24h, the booking still counts against your monthly allowance unless you transfer the seat. We don't reschedule on your behalf — book the new event normally.

title: Bringing a plus-one guest
body: Plus members get 1 plus-one per event; Elite get 4. Add the guest's name and email when reserving — we'll email them a unique guest ticket. Guests check in independently. Classic-tier members cannot bring plus-ones; upgrade to Plus to enable this.

title: Pause your Cult Pass membership
body: Plus and Elite members can pause for up to 90 days per calendar year from Settings > Membership > Pause. While paused you can't reserve events but your booking history and wallet stay intact. Resume any time. Classic-tier pauses are not supported; cancel and rejoin instead.

title: Update your payment method
body: Settings > Billing > Payment method. We accept Visa, Mastercard, AmEx, and Apple/Google Pay. New cards take effect on your next renewal; for failed invoices, tap 'Retry with new card'. Single-use virtual cards are accepted but may not auto-renew if rotated.

title: Why my payment failed
body: Most declines come from insufficient funds, expired cards, or banks flagging the charge as suspicious. We retry failed charges three times over five days. Membership downgrades to past_due after the third failure; reservations are paused until you update payment in Settings > Billing.

title: Reset your Cult Pass password
body: On the sign-in screen tap 'Forgot password?' and enter the email on file. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If it doesn't arrive, check spam, allow-list noreply@cultpass.test, or contact support — we'll verify your identity and resend.

title: Change the email on your Cult Pass account
body: Settings > Profile > Change email. We'll send a verification link to the new address; sign-in continues to use the old email until you click the link. Active reservations carry over automatically.

title: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)
body: Settings > Security > Add authenticator. Scan the QR with any TOTP app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy). Save the 10 backup codes — they're the only way to sign in if you lose your device. SMS 2FA is supported but discouraged for Elite accounts with payment changes enabled.

title: Export or delete your data (GDPR / CCPA)
body: Settings > Privacy > Request data. Exports (JSON + CSV of bookings, payments, profile) arrive by email within 72 hours. Deletion runs after a 7-day cool-off and is irreversible — backups are purged within 30 days. We retain anonymised attendance counts for capacity planning.

title: Cult Pass app is slow, freezing, or crashing
body: First force-quit and reopen. If it persists: update to the latest version, clear cache (Settings > Storage), free at least 500MB on the device. On Android 8 or below, disable animated artwork in Display settings. If crashes continue, send the in-app diagnostics report from Help > Send logs.

title: Event check-in and digital tickets
body: Tickets appear in the Wallet 24h before doors. Show the QR at check-in — it rotates every 30 seconds for security. Plus-one guests have separate QRs. If your phone is dead, ask the venue to look up your booking by member id (cp_m_xxx) and a photo ID.

title: Suspicious login or compromised account
body: If you see a sign-in you don't recognise: (1) change your password, (2) sign out all sessions in Settings > Security > Active sessions, (3) enable 2FA, (4) review recent activity in the audit log. Contact support if you see unauthorised reservations, payment-method changes, or data exports.
